task: within-user ranking of logged short-video impressions
label: long_view
interaction_semantics: Implicit-feedback impressions with chronological interaction, exposure-context, engagement, and watch-duration signals.

available_signals.description: Stable user, video, and creator identifiers support embeddings and interaction models.
The logged feed surface provides exposure context for each impression.
Video duration supports duration-aware long-view and watch-time modelling.
Chronological impressions permit training-side recent-history and preference-drift features.
Related observed engagement labels may provide auxiliary supervision for long_view.
Observed play time and content duration provide training-side engagement-intensity signals.
Public user-profile buckets describe activity and social-graph scale.
Public video metadata supplies content-side categories beyond identity.

assumptions: All method selection and outcome reasoning uses public metadata plus training and validation information only.
The primary objective is ranking each user's logged impressions rather than global probability calibration alone.
Method feasibility must be judged against the remaining iteration and wall-clock budget.
Available signals are capabilities, not permission to assume that the incumbent currently uses them.
